Welcome to Jagan Nath University
NAAC Accredited University in Jaipur, Rajasthan
Jagan Nath University, Jaipur
was established by an Act of the Rajasthan State Legislature (Act No. 19 of 2008) on April 16, 2008. It is approved under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956, accredited by
NAAC (2nd Cycle) with an “A” grade
in 2022, and is a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).
The University also holds a distinctive status in agriculture education: its
B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programme is
accredited by ICAR for 5 years
. Jagan Nath University offers
UG and PG
programmes across a wide range of disciplines.
